name: EZETIMIBA / SIMVASTATINA 10/20MG 14 TABLETS
description: Ezetimibe and simvastatin, when combined, serve to reduce total cholesterol, “bad” cholesterol (LDL), and triglyceride levels in the blood, and to raise “good” cholesterol (HDL). This combination is used to treat high cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of cardiovascular diseases, such as heart attacks and strokes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
